column1: # Tuning ideas tried by the loop in TUNING.md (issue #458). Append-only: add
# one row per try, kept or dropped, and never edit or delete a row.
# date: YYYY-MM-DD. idea: one line, no tabs. metric: the targeted metric.
# delta: score change vs accepted, e.g. -4.7%, or - when a gate failed.
# commit: short sha of the kept commit, or of the base the idea was tried on.
